author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: অনুচ্ছেদটি পড়ে নিজের ভাষায় সংক্ষিপ্তসার (summary) লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Discipline is the first condition of success. It means obedience to certain rules. We see discipline everywhere in nature. The sun rises and sets in time. A student must maintain discipline in his life. He must study, eat and sleep at the right time. A disciplined nation is always strong. So, we should be disciplined.'
items.model: Discipline, meaning obedience to rules, is the first condition of success. Nature itself is disciplined, as the sun rises and sets in time. A student must study, eat and sleep at proper times, and a disciplined nation is strong. So we should be disciplined.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Water is another name for life. We cannot live even a day without water. We use it for drinking, cooking and washing. But pure water is now becoming rare. People pollute water in many ways. This polluted water causes many diseases. So, we must keep our water free from pollution.'
items.model: Water is essential for life, as we cannot live a day without it and use it for drinking, cooking and washing. Yet pure water is becoming rare because people pollute it, and this causes many diseases. So we must keep our water free from pollution.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Science has made our life easy and comfortable. It has given us many wonderful things. The electric fan, the television and the mobile phone are its gifts. Science has removed distance by fast vehicles. It has also conquered many diseases. But science may also destroy us if it is misused. So, we should use it for good purposes.'
items.model: Science has made our life easy by giving wonderful gifts like the fan, television and mobile phone. It has removed distance through fast vehicles and cured many diseases. Yet, if misused, science may destroy us; therefore, we should use it only for good purposes.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Environmental pollution is a great problem today. The air, water and soil are being polluted every day. Smoke from mills and vehicles pollutes the air. Waste and chemicals pollute the water. This pollution harms our health in many ways. If we do not stop it, life will be in danger. So, we must protect our environment.'
items.model: Environmental pollution is a serious problem, as air, water and soil are polluted daily. Smoke pollutes the air, while waste and chemicals pollute the water, harming our health greatly. Unless it is stopped, life will be endangered, so we must protect the environment.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Drug addiction is a curse of modern time. Many young people are taking harmful drugs. They take drugs out of frustration or bad company. Drugs destroy their health and wealth. An addict often turns to crime. His family also suffers a lot. So, we should build awareness against drug addiction.'
items.model: Drug addiction is a curse of modern times, as many young people take harmful drugs due to frustration or bad company. Drugs ruin their health and wealth and often lead them to crime, making their families suffer too. So we must raise awareness against it.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Every student should have an aim in life. Life without an aim is like a ship without a rudder. A man with a clear aim can move forward steadily. He knows what he wants to be. He works hard to reach his goal. But an aimless man wanders here and there. So, we should set an aim early in life.'
items.model: Every student should have an aim in life, for life without an aim is like a rudderless ship. A person with a clear aim moves forward steadily and works hard to reach his goal, while an aimless man merely wanders. So we should fix an aim early in life.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Unity is strength. When people work together, they can do great things. A single man is weak, but many hands make work light. In union there is power. History shows that united nations win freedom. If we quarrel among ourselves, our enemies take advantage. So, we should always remain united.'
items.model: Unity is strength, for people working together can achieve great things. A single man is weak, but many hands make work light, and united nations have won freedom. Quarrelling among ourselves only helps our enemies, so we should always remain united.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Kindness is a great virtue. It means love and sympathy for all living beings. A kind man helps the weak and the poor. He is gentle even to animals. Kindness makes the heart pure and noble. It also wins the love of others. A cruel man is hated by all. So, we should be kind to all.'
items.model: Kindness, meaning love and sympathy for all living beings, is a great virtue. A kind person helps the weak and poor and is gentle even to animals, which makes his heart noble and wins others' love. A cruel man is hated by all, so we should be kind to everyone.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'A true friend is a great blessing. He stands by us in danger. He shares our joys and sorrows. He gives us good advice. A false friend flatters us in good times but leaves us in bad times. It is hard to find a true friend. So, we should choose our friends carefully.'
items.model: A true friend is a great blessing who stands by us in danger, shares our joys and sorrows and gives good advice. A false friend only flatters in good times and deserts us in trouble. Since true friends are rare, we should choose friends carefully.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Food adulteration is a serious crime. Some dishonest traders mix harmful things with food. They do it only to earn more money. Adulterated food causes many diseases. Children and old people suffer most. The government should punish such traders. We should also be aware while buying food.'
items.model: Food adulteration is a serious crime in which dishonest traders mix harmful things with food merely to earn more money. Such food causes many diseases, and children and the old suffer most. The government should punish these traders, and we should stay aware while buying food.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'A student has many duties. His first duty is to study attentively. He should also obey his teachers and parents. He must take part in games and social work. He should help the poor and the distressed. In future he will lead the nation. So, he should prepare himself well.'
items.model: A student has many duties, the first being to study attentively. He should obey his teachers and parents, take part in games and social work, and help the poor and distressed. As he will lead the nation in future, he should prepare himself well.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Truthfulness is the foundation of all virtues. A truthful man always speaks the truth. He never deceives others. People believe and trust him. Even his enemies respect him. A liar, on the other hand, is never trusted. Truthfulness brings peace and honour. So, we should always speak the truth.'
items.model: Truthfulness is the foundation of all virtues. A truthful man always speaks the truth and never deceives, so people trust him and even his enemies respect him. A liar is never trusted, while truthfulness brings peace and honour. Hence, we should always speak the truth.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Traffic jam is a common problem in big cities. It wastes our valuable time. It happens for many reasons. The number of vehicles is increasing fast. Many drivers do not obey traffic rules. Narrow roads also cause traffic jam. We should widen the roads and obey the rules to solve this problem.'
items.model: Traffic jam is a common problem in big cities that wastes valuable time. It occurs because the number of vehicles is rising fast, many drivers ignore traffic rules and roads are narrow. To solve it, we should widen the roads and obey the traffic rules.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Early rising is a good habit. He who rises early gets enough time for work. He can breathe fresh morning air. It is good for health. He can start his study with a fresh mind. Those who rise late always remain in a hurry. So, we should form the habit of early rising.'
items.model: Early rising is a good habit that gives one enough time for work and fresh morning air, which is good for health. An early riser studies with a fresh mind, while late risers always remain in a hurry. Therefore, we should form the habit of early rising.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'The mobile phone is a wonderful invention of science. It has made communication very easy. We can talk to anyone from anywhere. We can send messages and use the internet. But it has some bad sides too. Too much use of it harms our health. So, we should use the mobile phone carefully.'
items.model: The mobile phone is a wonderful invention that has made communication easy, letting us talk from anywhere, send messages and use the internet. However, its excessive use harms our health. Therefore, we should use the mobile phone carefully.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Physical exercise is essential for good health. It keeps our body fit and active. There are many kinds of exercise such as walking, running and swimming. Walking is the easiest and suits all. Exercise should be taken in the open air. A sound mind lives in a sound body. So, we should take exercise daily.'
items.model: Physical exercise is essential for good health, keeping the body fit and active. There are many kinds, such as walking, running and swimming, of which walking is easiest and suits all. It should be taken in the open air; as a sound mind lives in a sound body, we should exercise daily.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Population is a great problem in our country. The number of people is increasing very fast. There is not enough food, house and job for all. Many people live below the poverty line. Illiteracy is the main cause of this problem. We should build awareness to control our population.'
items.model: Population is a great problem in our country, as the number of people is rising fast and there is not enough food, housing or jobs for all. Many live below the poverty line, and illiteracy is the main cause. So we should raise awareness to control population.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Gardening is a good hobby. It gives us pleasure and profit. A gardener grows flowers, fruits and vegetables. Gardening keeps the body and mind fresh. It is also a good form of exercise. The flowers please our eyes and the fruits feed us. So, we should take up gardening in our free time.'
items.model: Gardening is a good hobby that gives both pleasure and profit. A gardener grows flowers, fruits and vegetables, and the work keeps body and mind fresh while serving as exercise. Flowers please the eyes and fruits feed us, so we should take up gardening in our free time.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Contentment is a great virtue. It means to be happy with what one has. A contented man is always happy. He does not run after too much wealth. Greed brings unhappiness and sin. A greedy man is never satisfied. Contentment gives peace of mind. So, we should be content with our lot.'
items.model: Contentment, being happy with what one has, is a great virtue. A contented man is always happy and does not run after wealth, whereas greed brings unhappiness and sin and a greedy man is never satisfied. As contentment gives peace of mind, we should be content.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Child labour is a curse for a nation. Many poor children work in factories and shops. They cannot go to school. They are deprived of their childhood. They work hard but get little money. This is against their rights. So, the government and the rich should come forward to stop child labour.'
items.model: Child labour is a curse for a nation, as many poor children work in factories and shops instead of going to school and are robbed of their childhood. They toil hard for little money, which violates their rights. So the government and the rich should act to stop it.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Courage is a noble quality. A courageous man does not fear danger. He faces every difficulty boldly. He never loses heart in trouble. The freedom fighters showed great courage in the war. A coward, on the other hand, dies many times before his death. So, we should be courageous in life.'
items.model: Courage is a noble quality; a courageous man does not fear danger but faces every difficulty boldly and never loses heart, as the freedom fighters showed in the war. A coward, however, dies many times before his death. So we should be courageous in life.
